description_expanded:
Dog Days on Beachberry | Watercolor, FL 30a

16 Beachberry Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Dog Days on Beachberry | 16 Beachberry Lane is a stunning 5 bedroom, 5 bathroom coastal retreat located in the WaterColor community, along scenic 30A. Complete with screened-in porches, a unique game room, and a separate carriage house, everything you and your pet need for an unforgettable getaway is right within reach.

This pet friendly property is just a short bike ride to beach accesses (0.5 mi) and includes access to all WaterColor community pools and the private beach club.

Designed for luxury and relaxation, the king suites throughout the home are thoughtfully appointed with private balconies, while the top floor features scenic rooftop seating perfect for soaking in the coastal surroundings.

Built for gathering in multiple areas of the home, on the first floor you will find a comfortable retreat for the family to spend time together, from the sun drenched dining nook to the open concept living space with a built-in beverage station. Across the hall, there is a king guest room with a shared hall bathroom. With multiple access points to outdoor areas throughout the home, this home truly has a space for everyone.

The second floor hosts the master bedroom suite, alongside two king guest bedrooms. The bedrooms are accompanied by expansive screened porches and plush seating.

The third floor includes an arcade space, 5 twin beds, and access to the top floor patio with a stunning view of Watercolor.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Dog Friendly: Max weight of the dog is 40lbs. You must notify us of the breed and weight of dog. Pet cleaning fee of $250 applies

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 14 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

- This home may have a video/audio capturing doorbell mounted by the door and/or exterior cameras for safety.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 to be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Mid-Stay Partial cleaning is required for stays of 5 to 13 nights.

- Mid-Stay Full cleaning is required for stays of 14 + nights.
